labels: enhancement

---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation
Why do you need this feature? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative approaches or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, examples, or references.

## ⚠️ Security Considerations
- [ ] This feature aligns with the responsible use policy in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md)
- [ ] No stealth, persistence, or unauthorized access mechanisms
- [ ] Explicit user approval required for monitoring/data collection

**Note**: Features that violate the security policy will not be merged.
